speaker: mary_shakespeare
text: The basket is covered. Do not make a host of her brother. He has sheep to get in.

speaker: anne_shakespeare
text: I know the path. The stiles will be wet. Thou art not carrying a speech as well as a basket.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: The basket, and the canvas. I am not opening either of them in the yard.

speaker: mary_shakespeare
text: Then go while the light is good. I am not coming. The shop can spare the pair of you for an afternoon.

speaker: anne_shakespeare
text: Cloaks. We are back before supper, and the question of supper can wait until we are back.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Before supper. I have the handle.
